topic: What to do when your mind goes blank on a video call
hook: Mind gone blank on a video call? Interview Sarthi shows you what to say in your own words.

slides.title: Buy time, politely.
points: "That is a good question, let me think for a second."
Repeat the question back in your own words.
Take one breath. Silence feels longer to you than to them.
slides.narration: Buy five seconds politely, then answer with your own real example.

slides.question: Why do you want to join us?
slides.answer: Start with the one thing you actually know about the company. Then connect it to one thing you did. Then stop.

caption:
Your mind goes blank in an online interview. Here is what to do in the next 5 seconds.

1. Buy time politely: "good question, let me think for a second."
2. Repeat the question back in your own words.
3. Anchor on one true thing, connect it to one thing you did, stop.

A calm pause reads as thinking. A rushed wrong answer reads as panic.

Save this for your next call.
